definitions.gloss: dark color; deep color; rich hue
definitions.explanation: A color that is dark, deep, or richly saturated — as opposed to a light or pale shade. Used as a general descriptor for any deeply saturated color, commonly in contexts involving clothing, dyes, food, beverages, and industrial products.

examples.japanese: {濃色|のうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃色|のうしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧。
examples.english: This soy sauce is dark in color and rich in flavor.

examples.japanese: {濃色|のうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衣類|いるい}→衣類：04680_irui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{色落|いろお}ち→色落ち：20012_iroochi⟧しやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Dark-colored clothing tends to bleed, so please wash it separately.

notes:
Compound of {濃|のう} ('thick; dense; dark') and {色|しょく} ('color'). A somewhat technical or formal term that appears commonly on product labels, care instructions, and in descriptions of food and beverages. In everyday speech, people more often say ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ ('dark color').

USAGE:
- Frequently seen on clothing care labels: {濃色|のうしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別洗|べつあら}い ('wash dark colors separately').
- In the beer and soy sauce industries, {濃色|のうしょく} describes darker varieties: {濃色|のうしょく}⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧ ('dark beer'), {濃色|のうしょく}⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ ('dark soy sauce').
- Can function as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {濃色|のうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧ ('dark-colored fabric').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃色|のうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衣類|いるい}→衣類：04680_irui⟧: dark-colored clothing
- {濃色|のうしょく}⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧: dark beer
- {濃色|のうしょく}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧: dark color range
- {濃色|のうしょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{淡色|たんしょく}: dark and light colors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {淡色|たんしょく}: light color; pale color — the antonym, used in the same formal/technical contexts
- {暗色|あんしょく}: dark color — emphasizes darkness or dimness rather than saturation
- ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: dark color — the everyday spoken equivalent
